page.overview:
Who is Gan Isurugi?

Gan Isurugi (石動 岩 Isurugi Gan) is a fighting game character from the Rival Schools series.

Gan is a fun-loving but simple-minded man who believe just about anything and for that, he'll almost never notice if someone is taking advantage of him. He always looks forward to having three meals a day, each meal always having five cups of rice stacked on top of the other in his bowl. For snacks, he likes onigiri (rice balls). His individual ending in Rival Schools: United by Fate also shows his dislike of studying.

In the School Life Mode of Nekketsu Seisyun Nikki 2, Gan's personality became more apparent from within the duration of the mode itself and that he doesn't participate in other various school events, with the exception of him taking a sumo practice with his instructor, Gengoro "Kinzan" Sado in that he shows and demonstrates his sumo fighting style. Aside from this, he also enjoys hanging out with both Edge and Akira in having to eat watermelons during the Beach Overnight.

Gan has short black hair and black eyes and is usually seen wearing a white headband with red linings. His Gedo High School uniform is different than the standard male Gedo High School uniform that's worn by Daigo because of his heavy weight. He wears a green school jacket with the right sleeve rips off to make it sleeveless, a brown wooden obi which resembles a mawashi worn by sumos, green school pants with rips at the edge, and gray geta sandals with the sandal lines being red. In Street Fighter V, he has brown patches at the right side of his pants and his geta sandals are black.
